proposals.label: Description

current.brief_description:
Every Mon, Tuesday, & Fri*
Get ready for the budget dream in Siem Reap tour package!
current.long_description:
Get ready for the budget dream in Siem Reap tour package! Dive into a perfect adventure that combine cultural experiences and festive ones!
Feel the pulse of Siem Reap's nightlife on the electrifying Pub Street. It's a carnival of fun – where beats drop, laughter echoes, and the night is always young. Then, wander off the beaten path to Road 60, the nearby fun fair, a treasure trove of local life. Here, you can blend in with the locals, challenge them in traditional games, and feel the warmth of authentic Cambodian hospitality. Get lost in the tantalizing scents of street eats, and revel in the infectious joy all around. Finally join our legendary cycling sunset tour with our Mad Monkey tour guide where you will bike through scenic countryside in Siem Reap and immerse in local culture.

proposals.label: Itinerary text

current.itinerary:
Pub Crawl
8:00 PM : Meet at the bar, order your first drink and enjoy meeting new Monkeys! Plus, in true Mad Monkey style, free shots on the hour starting at 8:30!
10:45 PM: Leave for the bars on Pub Street
We'll spend around 1 hour at each bar, with our first stop being a karaoke bar! We'll then head to a great spot with a pub-like atmosphere before dancing the night away at a club! 
1:00 AM : Return to Mad Monkey

Road 60
4:15 PM : Meet in the lobby
Grab your beer or soft drink for the tuk-tuk journey (travel time is 20 minutes)
5: 00 PM: Walk through the market with the tour guide and try various fruits, bugs (if you're brave enough!), desserts, food, and drinks.
After enjoying all the delicious treats, we will engage in some classic fair ground games such as balloon darts or bumper cars
7:00 PM : Return to Mad Monkey

Sunset countryside cycling tour
3:45 PM - Meet up in the hostel lobby for a quick briefing.
4:00 PM - Let's kick off our exciting 27km cycling adventure, exploring the beautiful countryside in the south of Siem Reap.
We'll make a few stops along the way to capture some amazing photos.
5:00 PM - We'll reach the ultimate sunset view spot, where you can relax and enjoy a refreshing beer or your favorite drink.
6:00 PM - As we head back to town, soak in the breathtaking sunset views that will leave you in awe.
7:00 PM - We'll finally arrive back at Mad Monkey!

Sunrise Angkor Wat
4:15 AM : Meet in the lobby. 
4:30 AM: Leave in the mini van direction Angkor Wat. Once we pass the ticket booth, the professional tour guide will bring you to the three main temples: Angkor Wat, Bayon, and Ta Prohm

12:30 PM : Head back to Mad Monkey   

Floating villages
1:45 PM - Meet at the lobby
2:00 PM - Depart Mad Monkey (travel time is approximately 1 hour)
3:00 PM - Hop on a boat for an hour cruise exploring the surrounding area. Arrive at the village and experince the local lifestyle
4:30 PM - Head back to the jetty to explore mangroves in small community boat. The cost is an additional $5 per person and helps to support the locals. If you prefer to stay on solid ground for a little longer, you can stay back at the local restaurant, Je Reap - or visit the small crocodile farm run by the restaurant. 
 5:30 PM - Head back to the boat to watch the sunset at the Tonle Sap lake. 
7:30 PM - Arrive back at Mad Monkey and enjoy a traditional Khmer meal and a beer or soft drink of your choice.

proposals.label: Itinerary text

current.itinerary:
Sunday: The Arrival
Check-in: Arrive, drop your bags, and get hyped for the Monday kick-off.

Monday: Meet the Crew & Kick Off
Day: Welcome session with the crew and surf instructors. Dial in your pop-ups, score your welcome pack + merch, and refuel with a group lunch. Finish the morning with a surf theory session.
Night: Head back to the hostel for Family Dinner & Karaoke showdowns.

Tuesday: Surf, Snap & Sparks
Day: Tuesday Run Club (for the brave). Fuel up at breakfast, then chase the best waves based on the daily weather. Back to base for lunch and a photo analysis session with the coaches to fix your form, followed by an afternoon surf session.
Night: Post-sunset beach bonfire and drinks under the stars.

Wednesday: Waves, Wheels & Wild Beats
Day: Breakfast, morning surf beach-hop, then back to the hostel for a legendary pool party and a chilled afternoon with drinks.
Night: Hit the surf skate meet-up at sunset, then rip up the dance floor for DJ Party Night.

Thursday: Video Proof & Beach Bonfires
Day: Breakfast and morning surf. Back for lunch and a video analysis session with the instructors to see yourself in action. Paddle back out for an afternoon surf.
Night: Another epic beach bonfire and drinks after sunset.

Friday: Paintball, Perks & Play
Day: Breakfast and morning surf. Back for lunch, leading into Friday arvo choices: paintballing or ring making (we'll read the room).
Night: Free evening to dive into whatever hostel chaos is going down.

Saturday: The Grand Finale
Day: One last morning surf with the crew, followed by a massive hostel BBQ and drinks.
Night: DJ Night for one final, unforgettable send-off.

Sunday: Check-Out
Morning: Final breakfast, check out, and goodbyes!

patch.brief_description: Siem Reap to Sihanoukville by Luxury Sleeping Bus (Giant ibis ) Include Water, Wi-Fi,…
patch.long_description:
Please make your way to the bus station at least 15 minutes before departure. The bus departs from the Giant Ibis bus terminal is located Behind Old Stadium, Khmer Pub Street. Departing from Siem Reap at 10.00pm and arriving in Sihanoukville at about 8am. Beds are 1.8 metres long. The bus includes water, a charging port, and a WC. It offers both double and single bed options. Once the bus departs, the Crew Attendant will distribute a bottle of water and cold towel, as well as a pillow and blanket. 
Complimentary pickup service is currently not available for night bus departures, however they offer free drop off at Sihanoukville Port Autonomous.

patch.brief_description: Siem Reap to Sihanoukville by Local Sleeping Bus (Olong Pich )
patch.long_description: A minivan will pick you up from the Mad Monkey Hostel up to 45 minutes before departure time and take you to the bus station. The mode of transportation provided is a local-style sleeper bus, equipped with double beds that are shared among passengers. While there is a charging port available, please be aware that there are no toilet facilities or wifi on board. However, the bus will make a stop every 3 hours for a toilet break. The estimated travel time is approximately 12 hours. We recommend that you bring your own earplugs and sleeping mask for added comfort during the journey.

Onboard wifi is available, but the connection might not be reliable. Finally, the bus will drop off passengers at the Giant Ibis ticket office in District 1 on Pham Ngu Lao Street in Ho Chi Minh City.

patch.brief_description: Sihanoukville to Ha Tien Town by Mini Van (Kampot Transports)
patch.long_description: To visit Vietnam, it is necessary to check for visa requirements for your country of passport. Some countries cannot enter on a visa on arrival and will need a to require an E-Visa beforehand with the correct border entry which is Prek Chak/Hatien Border. It is important to print out the e-visa before boarding the bus. A pickup car will arrive at the Mad Monkey Pier Office 30 minutes before departure. The transportation for the journey will be a 13-seat minivan. There will be a 30-minute rest stop in Kampot during the trip. Then, the journey will continue to the border crossing at Prek Chak (Cambodia) and Ha Tien checkpoint (Vietnam). At the border crossing, passengers will need to exit the bus to receive an exit stamp and go through immigration. Vietnamese customs will also scan luggage. Afterward, a mini-van on the Vietnam side will pick up passengers and continue the journey until reaching Mien Tay bus station. The entire trip will last approximately 4 to 5 hours, depending on the immigration process.

patch.brief_description: Phnom Penh to HCM by Air-Bus (VET) Include 1 Meal, Snack, Drinks, WC, Wifi / Non-stop
patch.long_description:
To visit Vietnam, it is necessary to check for visa requirements for your country of passport. Some countries cannot enter on a visa on arrival and will need a to require an E-Visa beforehand with the correct border entry which is Bavet/Moc Bai Border. 

At the border, you'll need to get off the bus to receive an exit stamp in your passport. A Crew Attendant will assist you and guide you back to the bus. After passing through Cambodian immigration, the bus will stop at a duty-free zone restaurant for lunch while your passports are processed at the Vietnamese immigration checkpoint. Vietnamese customs will scan your luggage, and locals may offer to help, but they may charge a $1 fee per bag. Finally, you'll be directed to the passport collection point before returning to the bus. The entire journey will take around 6 hours to reach your destination in Ho Chi Minh City.

St. Paddy’s Day at Mad Monkey Bangkok 🍀 2PM – 6PM: Paddy’s Foam Party – poolside chaos, green vibes & party warm-up 7PM – 9PM: 2-Hour Free Flow – unlimited spirit mixers 9PM onwards: Irish games & live DJ in the bar 11PM: Khao San Road Pub Crawl departure

Sign-up starts from 12 PM, with our free flow running from 1 PM to 3 PM. After that, we head straight into the street foam party with a live DJ, running through until around 8 PM. During this time, expect bucket promotions, happy hour deals, flash sales, Songkran games, prizes, and high-energy vibes throughout. From 8 PM onwards, the party continues with foam still going, while we move into live music inside the bar. We’ll also be running free shots every hour, giving away free buckets, and hosting karaoke and more Songkran games. The party goes late, finishing around 1 AM.
